mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an aggressive monetary easing that stimulates economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that drives wage growth and boosts consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment that supports economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and consumer spending signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts and consumer spending growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a monetary tightening that reduces borrowing and spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the federal funds rate is above 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in the unemployment rate and increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market that drives wage growth and boosts consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index signals a decrease in demand that reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the consumer price index is decreasing (t-test p > 0.05).
